message.content: An editorial illustration serves as the cover of Tempo magazine. Against a stylized landscape of green, pointed islands rising from turquoise water, three men are seated on a curved, brown sofa. The man on the left wears a brown suit, a white shirt, and a reddish-brown tie; the man in the center wears a grey military-style uniform with a peaked cap; and the man on the right wears a green military-style uniform and glasses. Their names, "Silas Papare," "Frans Kaisiepo," and "Marthen Indey," are printed below them. The background features grassy slopes with small white flowers. Above the men, large white text reads "Tiga Menguak Papua" over a sub-headline in smaller white letters. The red masthead "TEMPO" dominates the top third, with "Edisi Khusus Kemerdekaan" printed above it. A small red and white logo with the number "78" is in the top right. A barcode, QR code, and price information are in the bottom right corner. On the left edge, the vertical text "TIGA MENGUAK PAPUA" appears. The illustration style uses textured brushstrokes and exaggerated facial features.
